purpose: Measure whether native simulator contact-transition truth is a sufficient action-visible bridge for asymmetric bimanual pouring before spending on weak labels or WAM training.
non_claims: This specification is not evidence that transparent liquid or vessels reconstruct correctly from real RGB or depth.
A generated scenario manifest is not a simulated rollout and contains no physical result.
Inpainted, composited, diffusion-generated, reconstructed, or manually edited pixels are never ground truth.

timebase.action_timestamp_semantics: sample-and-hold command timestamp aligned to the first physics state after command application
timebase.event_timestamp_semantics: native physics crossing time, retained before resampling to policy_hz

embodiment_contract.asset_rule: Exact meshes, collision geometry, inertial properties, joint limits, transmissions, wrist frames, and calibration hashes are required. A driver source file or a generic two-jaw gripper is not an OmniPicker simulation asset.

native_event_rules.first_contact: first native positive normal impulse on an allowed effector-vessel pair after approach
native_event_rules.secure_grasp: bilateral jaw contact for OmniPicker or two non-collinear RH56 contact links, sustained for at least 0.10 s without vessel slip above 0.01 m
native_event_rules.pour_onset: first outward source-rim liquid flux above 0.5 mL/s sustained for at least 0.10 s
native_event_rules.pour_offset: outward source-rim flux below 0.5 mL/s for at least 0.20 s after pour_onset
native_event_rules.release: last allowed effector-vessel contact followed by at least 0.20 s separation
native_event_rules.forbidden_collision: forbidden pair impulse above 0.5 N.s or penetration above 0.002 m

factor_space.split_rule: Every non-OOD record uses only in_domain values. Every ood_test condition declares exactly one primary OOD axis and at least one value from that axis; no OOD value may occur in sanity or id_test.

design.method: deterministic balanced cyclic factor assignment; generator reports marginal counts and does not claim covering-array optimality
design.paired_rule: Every benchmark variant must evaluate the exact same scenario_id and physics/render/policy seeds.

native_ground_truth_contract.synchronization_rule: RGB, depth, segmentation, contact, liquid, and camera matrices must share an immutable native state_id; camera-to-state skew must not exceed 0.005 s.
native_ground_truth_contract.transparency_rule: Refraction and transparency affect the native RGB pass only. Labels come from native physical state or same-state render IDs, never from an edited observation. Native simulator depth is an oracle sensor channel, not a claim about real transparent-depth validity.

outcome_contract.volume_balance: initial_source_ml equals final_source_ml plus final_target_ml plus outside_ml within numerical tolerance
outcome_contract.overflow_fraction: volume crossing target rim after first entry divided by initial_source_ml; it may overlap outside_ml and is not added to mass balance
outcome_contract.collision_positive: maximum forbidden contact impulse > 0.5 N.s or maximum penetration > 0.002 m
outcome_contract.success: transfer_fraction >= 0.8 and spill_fraction <= 0.02 and not collision_positive and stable_duration_s >= 1.0
outcome_contract.correct_first_contact: predicted side, edge, and functional site equal native truth and absolute time error <= 0.10 s

gates.execution_readiness: All engine, asset, liquid, renderer, contact, camera, and calibration capability receipts must pass; spec_only_no_go must fail execution validation.
gates.mass_conservation: At most 1% of rollouts may have relative mass residual above 1%.
gates.repeatability: Within a fixed condition and variant, max minus min transfer_fraction across four seeds must not exceed 0.05.
gates.oracle_sufficiency: On ood_test, oracle_contact must exceed direct_action by at least 0.10 absolute task success and 0.15 absolute correct-first-contact.
gates.predicted_recovery: predicted_contact must recover at least 70% of both positive oracle_contact gains over direct_action.
gates.field_value: oracle_all_fields must improve OOD spill AUPRC by at least 0.05 absolute or reduce collision rate by at least 20% relative to rgb_only.
gates.claim_boundary: Passing a simulator gate supports only a controlled oracle ceiling. Real transparent reconstruction, real depth validity, and sim-to-real deployment require separate sensor-grounded evidence.
